question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Condision**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is '**Condition**'
 
• The incorrect spelling '**Condision**' has an extra '**s**' between '**d**' and '**i**'
 
• This error is a common mistake made while writing the word.
 
• '**Condition**' means the state or quality of something. (किसी चीज की अवस्था या गुणवत्ता)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Busy**' is spelt correctly and means having a lot to do or being occupied. (बहुत कुछ करना है या व्यस्त रहना है)
 
• '**Plane**' is spelt correctly and means a flat or level surface or an aircraft. (समतल सतह या वायुयान)
 
• '**Sponge**' is spelt correctly and means a porous cleaning tool or a type of marine animal.
